app.title: Local Skill Registry
app.tagline: Connecting Rural Talent with Local Opportunities
app.subheading: Discover informal and unorganized sector workers (masons, electricians, tailors, drivers, plumbers & more) in nearby villages with verified trust and privacy protection.
app.panchayatAffiliation: Govt E-Services & College Rural Engagement Initiative

search.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, skill (mason, electrician), village or tools...
search.showingResults: Showing {count} workers found in {total} total registry
search.noWorkersFound: No skilled workers match your search filters.
search.noWorkersHint: Try resetting your filters or search for another village or skill category.

contactModal.title: Request Worker Contact Details
contactModal.subtitle: Direct contact with {name} ({skill} • {village})
contactModal.privacyBanner: To protect rural informal workers from spam and predatory middlemen, contact details are guarded by the Gram Panchayat. The Panchayat Clerk verifies your request before releasing the phone number.
contactModal.orgPlaceholder: e.g. Govt Contractor, Gram Panchayat, Local Resident, Farmer
contactModal.purposePlaceholder: Describe the job: duration, village location, nature of work (e.g. Need mason for 10 days for school compound wall construction)...

contactSuccess.title: Contact Request Submitted!
contactSuccess.message: Your request has been forwarded to the Gram Panchayat Clerk for verification.
contactSuccess.copyNotice: Please save this Reference ID! You can track your approval status anytime on the 'Track Request' tab.

trackModal.title: Track Contact Request Status
trackModal.subtitle: Enter your Tracking Request ID or registered mobile number to check Panchayat clearance.
trackModal.inputPlaceholder: Enter Request ID (e.g. LSR-2026-1001) or 10-digit phone
trackModal.pendingMsg: Your request is currently awaiting review by the Panchayat Clerk. Typical turnaround is under 2-4 hours.
trackModal.approvedMsg: Your request was verified and approved! The worker's contact details are unlocked below:
trackModal.deniedMsg: This request was declined by the Panchayat. Reason:
trackModal.noRecord: No request record found for this identifier. Please verify your reference ID or phone number.

ratingModal.title: Rate & Review Worker
ratingModal.subtitle: Share your genuine feedback for {workerName}
ratingModal.starPrompt: Select your overall work satisfaction (1 to 5 Stars):
ratingModal.commentPlaceholder: Comment on work quality, punctuality, fair pricing, and tool handling...
ratingModal.successMsg: Thank you! Your review has been added to this worker's public profile.

registerPage.title: Add Worker to Registry
registerPage.subtitle: Register an informal skilled artisan or laborer into the Gram Panchayat directory for local job discovery.
registerPage.orNewVillage: Or enter village name if not in list
registerPage.phoneHint: This phone number will NEVER be shown publicly without Panchayat approval.
registerPage.eShramHint: e-Shram card links unorganized workers to national welfare and accident cover schemes.
registerPage.bioPlaceholder: Mention specific equipment owned (e.g. Has own drill and welding set, specialist in brick arches)...
registerPage.successMsg: The worker profile has been recorded. It will appear on the public directory with phone privacy protection.
